stem.text: A vertical shaft is drilled to an unknown depth D meters, where \( D > 5 \). The amount of dissolved salt per meter of depth is \( f(h) = 2 \sin{\left(\frac{h^{2}}{4} \right)} + 4 \) grams per meter for \( 0 \le h \le 5 \), where h is the depth in meters. Below depth 5 the amount per meter is an unknown continuous function g(h), and \( 0 \le g(h) \le 9 e^{5 - h} \) for \( h \ge 5 \), and \( \int_{5}^{\infty} 9 e^{5 - h}\,dh = 9 \). Let T be the total amount of dissolved salt, in grams, along the whole shaft. Write an expression involving integrals for T, and explain why \( T \le 31 \). Use a calculator for any numerical work.

answer_key.label: \( T = \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh + \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \), and \( T \le 31 \) because \( \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh \approx 21.722 \) and \( \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \le \int_{5}^{\infty} 9 e^{5 - h}\,dh = 9 \).

worked_solution.text: The model changes at depth 5, so split the total there: \( T = \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh + \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \).
Since \( 0 \le g(h) \le 9 e^{5 - h} \) and the interval from 5 to D lies inside the interval from 5 to infinity, \( \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \le 9 \). So \( T \le 21.722 + 9 < 31 \).

options.label: \( T = \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh + \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \), and \( T \le 31 \) because \( \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh \approx 21.722 \) and \( \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \le \int_{5}^{\infty} 9 e^{5 - h}\,dh = 9 \).
\( T = \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh + g(D) - g(5) \), and \( T \le 31 \) because \( \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh \approx 21.722 \) and \( \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \le \int_{5}^{\infty} 9 e^{5 - h}\,dh = 9 \).
options.derivation: the integral of g from the split depth to D written as g(D) - g(split), as though g were its own antiderivative

options.label: \( T = \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh + g(h), \text{ where } g(h) = \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \), and \( T \le 31 \) because \( \int_{0}^{5} f(h)\,dh \approx 21.722 \) and \( \int_{5}^{D} g(h)\,dh \le \int_{5}^{\infty} 9 e^{5 - h}\,dh = 9 \).
options.derivation: the unknown function set equal to its own integral and substituted for the second piece
